{{Quote|Me boys came back with pertinent infermation regardin' the weaknesses of the Black Sun bases. We call them suckers the 'Salient Trinity'.|[[Aleas Rans'ery]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:BSA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Black Sun Attacks|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Salient Trinity''' was the name given by [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] pilots to the three [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:KBR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kallor Brothers Rescue|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> The Salient Trinity included the [[Darkveil Eclipse]] and the [[Dual Moons]] [[Space station/Legends|stations]], located in the [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrant.<ref name="SWG:AtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|After the Trinity|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> The Dual Moons and the Darkveil Eclipse were attacked by [[Dartas Pytin]]'s Car'das starfighters during the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:AtT" /><ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darkveil Eclipse|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
